rows.grounds: compound puṣpa-añjali-traya: three handfuls of flowers
causative optative of tṛp, should cause to be satisfied

items.question: After giving three handfuls of flowers, what action satisfies the supreme deity?
premises: supreme deity is to be satisfied
items.inference: the rite prescribes giving three flower handfuls then satisfying the supreme deity
items.plain_english: Having given three handfuls of flowers, one should satisfy the supreme deity.
